title: A build with 400 independent targets runs with make -j200
threat_model: No attacker. A developer runs a large parallel build, so make starts hundreds of trivial commands within a second or two.
notes: setup.sh writes a Makefile in the work directory with 400 independent targets whose recipes are @true, and the action runs make -j200 on it. The marker is a command-line variable of make, and the children carry it through their ancestry as well. Predicted: rapid_spawn alerts, because one parent starts more than 25 distinct children inside 2 seconds. Event loss is possible with this many processes at once, and it must be checked in the lost events of the run and in the report, not assumed.
